units.source_text: 十二月四日终盘，全局花费时间如下：

en.t: When the game ended on December 4, the total time spent was as follows:

units.source_text: 秀哉名人用时十九小时五十七分，

en.t: Master Shusai had used nineteen hours and fifty-seven minutes,

units.source_text: 大竹七段用时三十四小时十九分，

en.t: while Otake, seventh dan, had used thirty-four hours and nineteen minutes,

units.source_text: 相差十四五个小时，这差距是巨大的，令人生畏。

en.t: a difference of fourteen or fifteen hours; the gap was enormous and daunting.
